title: QIF v0.6.1 Authoring Template Runtime
description: Add an executable authoring-template runtime so AI agents can generate QIF packages from explicit instructions, input/output contracts, local validation pipelines, golden cases, scoring rubrics, conformance results, and governance triggers.
validated_need: QIF needs a machine-readable authoring control layer because many future users and AI agents will produce QIF packages from natural-language requests, and prose-only guidance does not create reproducible conformance evidence.
intent: Make AI-generated QIF package authoring structurally valid, traceable, locally verifiable, and governable without claiming semantic truth or agent competence.
context: v0.6.0 already governs AI tool actions. The next Phase 3 gap is authoring templates that bind instructions, inputs, outputs, validation, examples, rubrics, runs, and conformance results.
triage_note: Implementation completed and released as v0.6.1. Release outcome is recorded in docs/aof-runtime-log.md.
